overview:
THIS TRIP

10 days in Tokyo and Kyoto by train, built around food and towns, history and culture and scenic viewpoints.

WHERE YOU SLEEP
1
Shinjuku
9
nights

One base, Shinjuku: also sleeping in Gion would not shorten the days and reach 3 more places, but the move would cost about 7 h 50 of packing up, checking in and travelling.

What this area holds that fits you fills about 3 of your 10 days; 7 days have nothing left within reach. A shorter stay here, or a few nights somewhere else, would use them better — or keep them as free days.
